goal: 为炎症性肠病（Inflammatory bowel disease）寻找可重定位的已上市药物及其作用机制
overview: 药物重定位为炎症性肠病（IBD）提供了新的治疗思路。阿托伐他汀通过PPARα依赖途径诱导肠道调节性T细胞扩增，有效缓解结肠炎症反应。异维A酸借助视黄酸信号重定向淋巴细胞运输，显著减少炎性细胞向肠黏膜浸润。维拉帕米阻断钙信号传导，抑制NLRP3炎症小体的异常活化，从而减轻IL-1β驱动的肠道炎症损伤。针对上皮屏障保护，去铁酮通过清除铁脂质过氧化阻止铁死亡，显著降低肠上皮细胞死亡。孟鲁

hypotheses.b: Activates PPARα in intestinal dendritic cells to promote regulatory T cell differentiation
hypotheses.statement: Atorvastatin alleviates IBD by PPARα-dependent induction of intestinal Tregs.
hypotheses.rationale: Statins upregulate PPARα, and PPARα agonists exhibit anti-inflammatory effects, suggesting a novel Treg-mediated mechanism.

reviews.critique: PPARα在肠道DC中诱导Treg的证据尚不充分。
PPARα-Treg pathway plausible but not unique to atorvastatin.
PPARα在肠道DCs的作用证据有限

hypotheses.b: Modulates retinoic acid signaling in intestinal dendritic cells, reducing CCR9+ pathogenic T cell homing
hypotheses.c: Decreases inflammatory cell infiltration into the gut
hypotheses.statement: Isotretinoin alleviates colitis by retinoic-acid-dependent redirection of lymphocyte trafficking.
hypotheses.rationale: Retinoic acid determines lymphocyte gut tropism; pharmacological modulation with isotretinoin may limit pathogenic T-cell recruitment.

reviews.critique: 视黄酸调控淋巴细胞归巢机制成熟，高剂量毒性需关注。
RA signaling in lymphocyte homing is established.
维甲酸调控CCR9归巢机制已知

hypotheses.b: Blocks L-type calcium channels to inhibit NLRP3 inflammasome assembly
hypotheses.statement: Verapamil suppresses NLRP3 inflammasome activation via calcium signaling blockade.
hypotheses.rationale: Calcium influx is essential for NLRP3 activation; verapamil, a calcium channel blocker, shows promise in dampening IL-1β-mediated pathology.

reviews.critique: 钙信号参与NLRP3组装已有共识，IBD特异性待定。
Ca2+ channel block inhibits NLRP3, well-known.
钙通道阻滞抑制NLRP3证据需加强

hypotheses.b: Chelates excess labile iron in intestinal macrophages, inhibiting ferroptosis and lipid peroxidation
hypotheses.statement: Deferiprone protects IBD epithelium by preventing ferroptosis.
hypotheses.rationale: Intraluminal bleeding leads to iron overload that triggers ferroptosis; the iron chelator deferiprone may mitigate this damage.

reviews.critique: 铁死亡在IBD中已证实，螯合剂全身影响需评估。
Macrophage-to-epithelium ferroptosis link needs data.
铁死亡在IBD上皮损伤中证据较好

hypotheses.b: Antagonizes cysteinyl leukotriene receptor CysLT1R, suppressing neutrophil extracellular trap formation
hypotheses.statement: Montelukast mitigates IBD hypercoagulability by blocking leukotriene-induced NETosis.
hypotheses.rationale: Leukotrienes enhance NET release; montelukast used in asthma may diminish microvascular thrombosis in IBD.

reviews.critique: CysLT1R介导NETosis的机制缺乏直接肠道证据。
NETosis-IBD link is novel; CysLT1R role emerging.
NETosis在IBD血栓中的作用待验证

hypotheses.b: Inhibits PDE4, upregulating IL-10-producing B regulatory cells in the gut
hypotheses.statement: Repurposed apremilast expands IL-10+ Breg cells to suppress IBD inflammation.
hypotheses.rationale: PDE4 inhibition elevates intracellular cAMP, promoting regulatory B cell profiles; this mechanism can be exploited for IBD.

reviews.critique: PDE4抑制上调Breg IL-10的因果关系需证实。
PDE4-induced Breg expansion has initial support.
PDE4抑制与Breg扩增关联需更多证据

hypotheses.b: Enhances mitophagy in intestinal epithelial cells via sigma-1 receptor activation
hypotheses.statement: Fluoxetine protects the intestinal barrier by sigma-1 receptor-mediated mitophagy.
hypotheses.rationale: Sigma-1 receptors regulate autophagy; fluoxetine is a known agonist, and autophagy defects are critical in IBD pathogenesis.

reviews.critique: Sigma-1受体活化mitophagy在肠上皮中属全新假设。
Sigma-1 mitophagy in IEC barrier lacks direct proof.
Sigma-1R介导肠上皮线粒体自噬证据弱

hypotheses.b: Blocks angiotensin II type 1 receptor on intestinal fibroblasts, reducing TGF-β-driven fibrosis
hypotheses.statement: Losartan inhibits intestinal fibrosis by attenuating AT1R/TGF-β crosstalk.
hypotheses.rationale: AT1R signaling promotes fibrosis; losartan as an ARB is effective in renal fibrosis, warranting evaluation in gut fibrosis.

reviews.critique: AT1R/TGF-β crosstalk明确，但肠道纤维化模型需验证。
AT1R/TGF-β axis in fibrosis is well-supported.
AT1R/TGF-β轴在肠纤维化中较明确

hypotheses.b: Inhibits carbonic anhydrase activity, lowering luminal pH to favor SCFA-producing bacteria
hypotheses.c: Shifts microbiota toward anti-inflammatory short-chain fatty acid output
hypotheses.statement: Indapamide remodels the IBD microbiome by modulating intestinal pH via carbonic anhydrase inhibition.
hypotheses.rationale: Carbonic anhydrase inhibitors alter ion transport and microclimate; indapamide may promote symbiotic bacteria growth.

reviews.critique: 肠道碳酸酐酶调节pH进而改变菌群缺乏体内实证。
Intestinal CA inhibition by indapamide unverified.
碳酸酐酶抑制调控微生物组需验证

hypotheses.statement: Probenecid→Relieves NLRP3-driven colitis: Probenecid blocks pannexin-1 channels to reduce extracellular ATP and prevent NLRP3 inflammasome assembly in intestinal macrophages.
hypotheses.rationale: Probenecid is a safe approved uricosuric that inhibits pannexin-1, limiting danger signal ATP release; this upstream block of NLRP3 activation could uniquely treat autoinflammatory colitis distinct from calcium signaling.
hypotheses.self_novelty: High: pannexin-1 targeting in IBD is unexplored, and probenecid provides an immediate clinical opportunity.

reviews.critique: Pannexin-1/ATP/NLRP3轴证据较好

hypotheses.b: Activates PPARα to enhance fatty acid oxidation in intestinal epithelial cells, providing energy for repair
hypotheses.statement: Fenofibrate promotes mucosal repair by PPARα-mediated epithelial fatty acid oxidation.
hypotheses.rationale: Epithelial restitution is energy-intensive; fenofibrate supports anti-inflammatory and metabolic programs for wound healing.

reviews.critique: PPARα促脂肪酸氧化修复黏膜，逻辑合理但需损伤模型。
PPARα-FAO in mucosal healing has prior data.
PPARα促上皮能量代谢逻辑合理

hypotheses.b: Activates AMPK to promote MUC2 mucin secretion by goblet cells
hypotheses.statement: Metformin strengthens the mucus layer through AMPK-dependent MUC2 secretion.
hypotheses.rationale: AMPK activation is linked to barrier function, and metformin ameliorates colitis; specifically enhancing mucin secretion is a novel angle.

reviews.critique: AMPK驱动MUC2分泌的直接证据有限。
AMPK-driven MUC2 secretion is rational.
AMPK-MUC2通路较明确

hypotheses.b: Elevates extracellular adenosine by inhibiting uptake, activating A2A adenosine receptors to polarize M2 macrophages
hypotheses.statement: Dipyridamole drives M2 polarization through adenosinergic signaling as an IBD therapy.
hypotheses.rationale: Dipyridamole increases adenosine levels; A2A receptor activation robustly promotes anti-inflammatory M2 macrophages.

reviews.critique: 腺苷A2A促M2极化通路明确，抗血小板混淆疗效。
Adenosine-A2A M2 polarization widely reported.
腺苷A2A驱动M2极化机制支持

hypotheses.statement: Riluzole alleviates IBD by activating enteric glial TREK-1 channels to reduce neurogenic inflammation and protect barrier integrity.
hypotheses.rationale: TREK-1 activation stabilizes enteric glial membrane potential, limiting pro-inflammatory mediator release from glia and preventing epithelial leak.
hypotheses.self_novelty: Moderately novel: first repositioning of a glial potassium channel opener for neuro-immune interplay in IBD.

reviews.critique: Enteric glial TREK-1 role remains to be established.
肠胶质TREK-1调节神经炎症证据薄弱

hypotheses.b: Inhibits SGLT2 in intestinal epithelium, limiting glucose uptake and glycolysis required for Th17 differentiation
hypotheses.c: Attenuates pathogenic Th17 responses in the gut
hypotheses.statement: Empagliflozin restricts glycolytic fuel for Th17 cells via intestinal SGLT2 blockade.
hypotheses.rationale: SGLT2 is expressed in the gut; reducing local glucose availability can selectively impair pro-inflammatory Th17 cell metabolism.

reviews.critique: SGLT2在肠道限制糖供给影响Th17分化过于间接。
Local SGLT2 limiting Th17 glycolysis unconfirmed.
肠上皮SGLT2抑制限制Th17糖酵解新颖

hypotheses.statement: Metformin treats IBD by activating AMPK to concurrently suppress NLRP3 inflammasome and prevent ferroptotic death in intestinal epithelial cells.
hypotheses.rationale: AMPK activation hinders NLRP3 priming and boosts GPX4 synthesis, thus blocking both pyroptosis and ferroptosis.
hypotheses.self_novelty: Highly novel: dual block of pyroptosis and ferroptosis by a single metabolic modulator.

reviews.critique: AMPK pleiotropy known; combo not highly novel.
AMPK双重机制合理但非新发现

hypotheses.statement: Minocycline→Preserves intestinal barrier integrity: Minocycline inhibits PARP-1 to attenuate inflammatory enterocyte apoptosis and maintain tight junction proteins in colitis.
hypotheses.rationale: Minocycline, a brain-penetrant antibiotic, is a validated PARP-1 inhibitor that reduces cell death and inflammation; applying this anti-apoptotic action to gut epithelial cells could fortify the barrier without immunosuppression.
hypotheses.self_novelty: High: repurposing minocycline for gut barrier protection via PARP-1 is a novel mechanistic jump from its neuroprotective use.

reviews.critique: PARP-1保护肠屏障机制文献支持

hypotheses.b: Inhibits serotonin transporter to increase 5-HT, activating 5-HT4 receptors on enteric neurons for survival
hypotheses.statement: Paroxetine rescues enteric neurons via 5-HT4 receptor neuroprotection.
hypotheses.rationale: IBD involves neurodegeneration; 5-HT4 agonists are neurotrophic and anti-inflammatory, suggesting paroxetine as a neural rescue therapy.

reviews.critique: 5-HT4受体神经保护外周应用需排除中枢效应。
5-HT4 neuroprotection in enteric neurons is plausible.
5-HT4受体神经保护在IBD中未知

hypotheses.b: Converts peripherally to dopamine, activating D1 receptors on intestinal dendritic cells to suppress IL-12/23 release
hypotheses.statement: Levodopa alleviates IBD through peripheral dopaminergic inhibition of the IL-12/23 axis.
hypotheses.rationale: Dopamine modulates immune responses; levodopa, a Parkinson's drug, may dampen pathogenic dendritic cell cytokine production in the gut.

reviews.critique: 多巴胺能调节DC细胞因子可行，外周转化效率存疑。
Dopamine-D1 on DCs needs IBD-specific validation.
外周多巴胺抑制IL-12/23证据极少
